description: This file defines the JobCategory entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties for id and name, with associated getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to a database table.

classes.name: JobCategory
classes.description: Entity class representing a job category, with properties for id and name, mapped to the ohrm_job_category table.
